replies.author: _Mx_
replies.body:
First off, I always thought you weren't supposed to use texture packs. Could be wrong, though.

To be honest, it doesn't look very exciting. Not much block variation, a lot of void, and there's nothing that gives it a special spark.
It's a great base, but it looks like there's a lot you could add on. Personally, I would introduce the following.

- More block variation. Perhaps mycelium, coarse dirt, scattered leaves etc.
- Maybe some chests? Something that makes this map have a special spark to it.
- You could expand the curved symmetrical sides that lead to the teams spawn via the skinny stretch of land. 
- Perhaps add some buildings? Or trees? Anything that spices up the landscape.
- Personally, I can't even see the monuments. If they are those things close to the trees, then personally I think that's too close. It'll be easy to get to.
- Change around spawn - make it look nicer.
- Overall expand the map and add onto it.

I'm aware that I'm not qualified at all to make suggestion for a map, but these are just my opinions.

Apart from this, it's an outstanding start to a map that could have potential ;3
